search.snippet: Marigold seeds can be planted in a flower patch at level 2 Farming to yield marigolds, which are used to make imp repellent or as payment to protect hammerstone hops. When fully grown, it protects potato, onion, and tomato plants in neighbouring allotments from disease.
search.title: Marigold seed - OSRS Wiki

search.snippet: A marigold seed is used in the Farming skill to grow Marigolds. They may be obtained by pickpocketing Master Farmers stealing them from Olivia s seed stall in Draynor Village or purchasing them from either Olivias Draynor Seed Market or Coeden s seed store.

search.snippet: Here’s exactly how I start mine: Pre-moisten your seed starting mix so it’s evenly damp, not soaking. This helps with consistent germination and good seed to soil contact. Marigold seeds are long and thin, so plant them about a quarter inch deep.
